title: telemetryd's messages don't show up anywhere -- not even right now
description_md:
`telemetryd` is supposed to log through the system journal, but nothing it emits ever turns up in `journalctl` -- not even messages sent seconds ago, in this exact boot, before anyone has rebooted anything. It isn't a reboot-persistence problem; the messages seem to vanish the instant they're sent. SSH in as `trainee` (passwordless `sudo`), figure out why journald isn't retaining anything at all right now, and fix it.

You're done when a message emitted through the journal (e.g. via `logger`) actually shows up in a `journalctl` query immediately afterwards.
